results.description:
A Row Counter App optimized for knitting and crocheting: 

___ IMPORT YOUR PATTERN ___
# Download your patterns directly into the app, be it a webpage or a pdf, from the web or from your phone, Dropbox or Google Drive
# Create knitting and crochet charts that you can then use as pattern in your project
# Direct access to Ravelry, so you can search their website or access your library.

__ CUSTOMIZE YOUR ROW COUNTER ___
# Set up several counters to keep track of your increases, design, or change of color
# Add reminders to appear on a specific row: you will knit mistake-free!
# You just need a basic counter? No worries, you can also use it without any configuration

___ VOICE CONTROL ___
# No need to touch the app while knitting, just speak to it to increment the counter, and keep your hands free to do beautiful things!

__ FOLLOW UP ON YOUR PROGRESS ___

results.description:
Knit Row Counter is a small app to count the rows of knitting.

iPhone Gestures:
• One tip increases the counter by 1
• Swipe left / right decrements the counter by 1
• Long touch (2 seconds) resets the counter to 0

Watch Gesture
• Long touch resets the counter to 0

Easy Knitty row counter, row tracker is your new yarn app or knitting tool for all your knit and crochet projects. 

Tracking and counting your rows has never been easier with that knit companion. We have asked knitting enthusiasts what they want and we have developed the manual counter app focused on user experience. That's why we've included features such as a huge "add row" button or why we didn't include any bothering sounds stopping your favorite podcast... we have simply made a user-friendly knitting tool to help all the knit and yarn lovers that we are!


____MAIN FEATURES OF THE EASY KNITTY ROW COUNTER APP____ 


- Huge "Add Row" button that you can easily smash
- Create, Edit or Delete Projects with 1 or several parts
- Create, Edit or Delete Parts of projects (in other words: sub-projects)
- Counting rows 1 by 1 or X by X (can be use as a stitch counter as well)
- Add/Remove rows or reset the row counter
- Using the stopwatch to track how long you spend on each part of your knitting or crochet project
- Alternatively you can use the stopwatch to track the time for each of your knitting sessions
- Adding notes about a specific project (Project status, Needle Size, Project starting date, Yarn details and Dye Lot)
- Adding extra notes for each part directly on the row counter page
- Design and development focused on user experience
- NO sound (that means: listen to your podcast or favorite playlist freely with another app in the background)
- Manual counter 
- Dark mode

____STAY IN TOUCH GUYS____ 


This new app has been designed by a young couple of 1 professional developer and 1 passionate knitter. We would love to get your review on that knit row counter app, but also feedback and ideas for feature improvements!

Thank you and enjoy!

results.description:
StitchTally is a simple and intuitive app designed to help you keep track of the number of rows you've crocheted or knitted. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced crocheter, StitchTally makes it easy to monitor your progress and stay organized.

Features

- EASY TO USE: StitchTally features a user-friendly interface that allows you to focus solely on crocheting without distractions.
- GOAL SETTING: Easily set and track goals for each project, with StitchTally counting down to help you stay motivated.
- UNLIMITED COUNTERS: Manage as many projects as you like, making it especially beneficial for amigurumi crochet enthusiasts.
- FOCUS MODE: Enjoy a full-screen focus mode that helps you concentrate on counting your rows, while preventing your phone from sleeping (without draining your battery).
- IPAD SUPPORT: StitchTally supports iPad, with a better user experience.
- ICLOUD SYNC: Now your counters are automatically synced across all your devices, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Never lose your counters again!
- APPLE WATCH: Use the Counters app on your watch with synced counters for on-the-go counting.
- TUTORIAL VIDEOS: Forget how to do a certain stitch? No problem! We've got you covered with a series of tutorial videos to help you learn how to crochet.
- SYMBOL & ABBREVIATION LOOKUP: Look up symbols and abbreviations for crochet patterns.
- FUN DESIGN: This app uses a lot of emojis to make it fun, cute and memorable.

Why I built StitchTally?

I fell in love with Amigurumi crochet! They are very cute and fun to make. However, I found it difficult to keep track of my progress for each part of the amigurumi. I wanted an app that is very simple and easy to use, so I can focus on crocheting.

That's when I decided to build StitchTally. I'm still using it for my own amigurumi projects every day, and added some features that I found useful.

results.description:
Meet CozyKnit Counter: your simple, delightful way to count rows & stitches and keep your patterns, notes, and materials organized in one place.

Knit (or crochet) with everything you need at your fingertips--smart counters, pattern details, yarn from your stash, progress, annotations, notes, and photos--so you can stay in the flow now and pick up right where you left off later.

--Smart, simple counters designed especially for knitters--
• Flexible tracking for every pattern: rows, stitches, shaping, repeats, and more
• Use smart rules for automatic increases/decreases and resets (perfect for ribbing, lace repeats, and sleeve shaping)
• Create multiple counters per project (sleeves, repeats, sections)
• Add custom row-by-row instructions so you can knit without constantly checking your pattern
• Upload your pattern for easy access as you count
• Sync project progress across all of your devices

--All-in-one knitting project management--
Create as many projects as you need--each with a cute, colorful icon and its own counters. Quickly see your progress at a glance. Lock project progress to avoid accidental clicks!
• Keep your pattern details in one place so you can reference them mid-project
• Add tags to organize your pattern library and find things fast
• Store your needles and yarn used for quick lookup, and update your stashed amounts as you progress
• Add and view project photos to track progress visually
• When you come back weeks (or months) later, everything is still there as a project record

--Pattern annotations--
Highlight and mark up your pattern as you go:
• Add highlights, notes, and bookmarks
• Keep your annotations tied to the pattern so your reminders are always there when you return

--Stash + yarn tracking (that syncs with projects)--
• Track & store the yarn you have in your stash (specs, photos, notes, etc.)
• Assign stash yarn to projects, then log yarn used as you go
• When you update yarn used in a project, it automatically updates your stash too

--Stay focused with timed sessions--
Track your knitting pace, keep your screen awake, and enjoy a distraction-free counter experience that keeps you in the flow. Add row-by-row instructions to callout next steps without needing to open your pattern file. Based on your speed, CozyKnit Counter can estimate time remaining to reach your goal.

--Insights & analytics--
See your knitting life at a glance with stats like:
• Pace over time
• Average project duration
• Rows knit
+ filter by project!

--Double-check every click--
A built-in change log history makes it easy to confirm what changed (and when)—especially helpful for complex counters and long projects.

--Made to feel cozy--
A soft color palette, clean UI, and gentle animations make tracking your knitting feel…nice.

--Perfect for all skill levels--
Whether you’re on your first scarf or your twentieth sweater, CozyKnit Counter makes it easy to track progress and stay on pattern--at home or on-the-go.

--Why knitters and crocheters love CozyKnit Counter--
• Super simple and easy to use--no clutter or extra clicks
• All-in-one counter, stash, pattern, and project management tool
• Beautiful, cozy design
• Ideal for managing multiple projects: sweaters, hats, scarves, shawls, socks, blankets & more
• Great for patterns with repeats or multiple pieces
• Lets you track as little or as much as you want
• Keeps your screen awake during sessions
• Pace metrics, time remaining estimates, and insights over time
• Syncs across devices
